nodes.label: LoyalCard QR Code Screen Screenshot
nodes.description: App screenshot showing the LoyalCard digital loyalty card QR code screen in Romanian, with dark themed background, back navigation, EN/RO language toggle, a card panel titled 'Codul tau QR' containing a large scannable QR code, an instructional hint to show the code at checkout to earn rewards, and a unique card ID (LOYALCARD-54AC5D75).

nodes.label: QR Code Display Feature
nodes.description: UI feature showing a scannable QR code representing the user's digital loyalty card, intended to be shown at checkout ('casa') to accumulate rewards/points.

nodes.label: Loyalty Card Unique Identifier
nodes.description: Displayed unique card identifier string 'LOYALCARD-54AC5D75' shown beneath the QR code as a fallback/reference code for the loyalty card.

nodes.label: EN/RO Language Toggle
nodes.description: UI control in the top right allowing the user to switch the interface language between English (EN) and Romanian (RO); RO is currently active.

nodes.label: Dark Themed Branding with Gold Accent Background
nodes.description: Visual design pattern: dark/black background with a soft glowing gold-yellow gradient blur, bold white 'LoyalCard' title and tagline 'Cardul tau de fidelitate digital' (Your digital loyalty card), reflecting a premium loyalty-app aesthetic.
